theme.strategy: Light Dominant (Organic & Earthy Archetype) with a radical Dark Mode tension section.
theme.vibe: Awwwards-level, traditional-Indian-meets-premium-editorial. Think 'Aesop' but deeply rooted in Indian Lakdi Ghani heritage. High-contrast typography, generous negative space, warm tactile surfaces.

font_pairings.usage: Hero typography, large section titles. Creates an elegant, editorial, heritage feel.
For the bilingual brand voice like 'गांव की घानी से सीधा आपके घर तक'. Pairs beautifully with Cormorant Garamond.
Clean geometric contrast for product specs, prices, and navigational UI. Highly legible.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous. Use 2-3x typical spacing (e.g., py-24 or py-32 for sections) to let the photography and typography breathe.
layouts.grid_strategy: Asymmetrical Bento (Tetris mode) for the 'Journey' section. Do not use generic 3-column equal grids for products; alternate alignments or use staggered heights.
layouts.alignment: Left-aligned dominant for text heavy blocks to maintain editorial structure. Center-aligned ONLY for the Manifesto/Story statements.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle noise/grain overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire site to remove digital flatness and enhance the 'organic' feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #1F2922 with 15% opacity for separating grid items or table rows. No heavy drop shadows. Rely on 'Clay & Crisp' subtle depth if needed.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Use soft arch motifs (Indian architectural nod) for masking product images or founder portraits.

motion.scrolling: MUST use 'lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling. This is critical for the premium feel.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion line-by-line masked reveals for all H1 and H2 elements (initial y: 100%, overflow: hidden).
motion.parallax: Apply subtle Y-axis parallax to background images in the 'Journey' section.
motion.micro_interactions: Product cards: on hover, the bottle image scales up by 5% and the background arch slightly shifts color.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped, bg-[#C04A22] text-[#FAF7F2]. On hover: scales down slightly (scale-95) instead of up, background darkens.
buttons.secondary: Outline button with 1px border. border-[#1F2922] text-[#1F2922]. Hover: bg-[#1F2922] text-[#FAF7F2].
buttons.whatsapp: Use the primary style but append a WhatsApp SVG icon.

product_card.structure: Image heavy. Bottle centered within a large soft-colored background (e.g., #EBE4D5). Title and price left-aligned below.
product_card.action: Two buttons on hover/bottom: 'Buy Now' (direct to WA) and 'Add to Cart'.

cart_drawer.design: Slide-in from right. Clean, minimal. White/Bone background.
cart_drawer.functionality: Lists selected products, quantities (+/-), and calculates total MRP and Discounted Price. 'Order on WhatsApp' button at the bottom.

whatsapp_integration.logic: Construct a dynamic URL: `https://wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX?text=[URL_ENCODED_STRING]`. The string should read: 'Hello Padam Naturals! I want to order: %0A- 2x Groundnut Oil (1L) - ₹560 %0ATotal: ₹560. Please confirm my order.'

hero.layout: Massive typography ('गांव की घानी से सीधा आपके घर तक') overlapping a clipped-arch image or video loop of oil pouring. A floating '100% PURE & UNREFINED' badge rotating slowly in the corner.

marquee.design: The 'Editorial Ribbon'. bg-[#EBE4D5] text-[#1F2922]. Slow, smooth drift. Text: 'Khaane Ka Swaad, Sehat Ke Saath ✦ No Heat, No Chemicals ✦ 100% Natural'. Font: Cormorant Garamond, italicized.

products_grid.layout: Staggered grid of the 6 oils. Groundnut, Sunflower, Sesame, Coconut, Mustard, Almond. Each card feels like an art piece.

comparison_table.vibe: The Tension Point. This entire section inverts to Dark Mode (bg-[#141C16]).
comparison_table.design: Editorial table comparing 'Lakdi Ghani' vs 'Refined Oil'. High contrast gold (#DDA74F) text for Padam Naturals column, muted grey for Refined. 1px gold borders.

journey_manifesto.layout: Numbered scrolling sticky section. Left side: Massive numbers (01, 02, 03) and text ('From the Farms', 'Churned in Lakdi Ghani', etc.) pinning to the screen. Right side: Corresponding beautiful photography scrolling past.

instructions_to_main_agent.framework: React (.js) + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion. Do not use .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Set up a standard multi-page router (react-router-dom) with Home, Shop, About, Contact. Alternatively, since it's a creative site, single-page with sections mapped to navigation is acceptable if executed brilliantly.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Use Context API or Zustand to manage the Cart state globally across pages.
instructions_to_main_agent.whatsapp_logic: Write a utility function `generateWhatsAppLink(cartItems)` that dynamically creates the wa.me link. Assume dummy phone number '919876543210' if not provided.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn: Use Shadcn components for the Cart Drawer (Sheet), FAQs (Accordion), and minimal elements. Overwrite Shadcn's default 'Vercel' look to match the organic brand.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts_installation: Add Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Rozha One, Manrope to the index.html.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Embrace asymmetry and the grid constraints defined.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT heavy drop shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters ONLY when scrolling content dictates it (like sticky header).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Add `data-testid` to all buttons, links, and form inputs for testing purposes.
